subject: Approval lanes, invoice remit and vendor onboarding timetable
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Greene <samantha@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: approval lanes and vendor intake items (post-demo)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for a productive demo earlier today. Quick recap and items we promised to capture: 

- Economic buyer: Linda Park (CFO) — Samantha to confirm final approval path.
- Procurement lead: Jorge Martinez (Vendor Ops / Procurement).
- Security evidence needed: SOC2 Type II, data flow diagram, data retention policy.
- PO & invoicing: Orchid prefers PO before first invoice; remit to Finance (address and AP contact below).
- Timeline: Orchid aiming for vendor onboarding the week of May 10; they indicated finance cycles that close on the 15th.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I attach a short vendor intake form for Jorge to complete — this will help our onboarding ops.
2) Samantha — can you confirm Linda + Jorge and whether your legal team needs pre-negotiated terms?
3) Aditya will share the Ops checklist and SOC2 summary we can provide immediately.

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf (PDF) 

Thanks — I’ll follow up in two business days if I don’t hear back.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samantha Greene <samantha@orchidhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jorge Martinez <jorge.martinez@orchidhealth.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: approval lanes and vendor intake items (post-demo)

Hi Naomi — thanks for the recap and the form. Quick confirmations: 

- Confirmed economic buyer: Linda Park (CFO). She will give final sign-off but prefers procurement to validate vendor paperwork first.
- Procurement lead: Jorge Martinez (copied). Jorge owns vendor intake and PO routing.
- Legal: we generally use our standard PO + SOW; legal will only escalate if deviations > standard terms.
- Finance cadence: invoices must reference a PO number; payment terms are Net30 after invoice receipt.

Timeline: Jorge expects to run the intake the week of Apr 26 and can provide feedback by Apr 29. If all goes well we should be able to raise a PO in the week of May 10, with payment expected within the normal Net30 window.

I’ve attached the SOW template that our finance team uses internally so you can confirm it maps to Redwood’s billing cadence.

Attachments: sample-sow-ORCHID-Redwood.docx (DOCX)

Thanks,
Samantha Greene
Head of Partnerships, Orchid Health
Samantha.GreenE@orchidhealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: approval lanes and vendor intake items (post-demo)

Hi Samantha / Naomi — quick technical & ops notes to help Jorge move the intake faster: 

- We can provide our SOC2 Type II summary and a short data flow diagram for your security questionnaire. Attached is a concise summary that covers authentication model and the limited PII handling flow.
- Billing: Redwood issues invoices monthly. If Orchid needs milestone invoicing we can map that in the SOW but will need PO line items that reference the milestones.
- Remit details: Redwood requests remit to "Redwood Inference, Inc." with AP contact invoices@redwood.ai. If you need an alternative remit address for Orchid's AP system, flag it now.
- Onboarding window: Our onboarding ops typically needs 7–10 business days from signed SOW/PO to stand up tenant + test keys. If PO is raised week of May 10, we can target go-live May 21–25.

Attachments: SOC2-type2-redwood-summary.pdf (PDF)

If Jorge wants a short checklist for vendor intake fields we can drop a prefilled example into the vendor-intake-form to speed review.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Greene <samantha@orchidhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jorge Martinez <jorge.martinez@orchidhealth.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@orchidhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: approval lanes and vendor intake items (post-demo)

Thanks — all helpful. Jorge and I reviewed the intake form and the SOW template this morning. Quick decisions/outcomes: 

- Jorge will complete the vendor intake form by Apr 29 and return it to Naomi and me.
- Legal: no major deviations expected; they will flag anything unusual but likely accept standard SOW.
- PO timing: finance confirmed PO issuance target week of May 10; they will create PO that references milestone line items (as Aditya suggested).
- Payment terms: Net30 to Orchid's AP (we will provide PO+PO number when issued).

Action items: 
- Naomi: please send a prefilled vendor-intake-form (we can truncate optional fields) to Jorge to speed the review.
- Aditya: please drop the SOC2 summary and a one-page operations checklist into the intake form as attachments.
- Samantha/Jorge: once intake is complete, we’ll route to Linda for final sign-off.

I’ll circulate Jorge’s completed intake once it’s ready.

Best,
Samantha
